newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai offshore bank loans edge up in Dec over Nov.
newsitem.headline: Thai offshore bank loans edge up in Dec over Nov.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said total outstanding loans extended by offshore banking units rose to 1.29 trillion baht ($49.6 billion) at the end of December last year from 1.28 trillion baht the previous month.
The loans were granted through the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF).

The central bank said the loans brought in by commercial banks for relending to domestic borrowers (out-in) was up two percent to 807.6 billion baht at the end of December from 791.9 at the end of November.

Cummulative foreign loans of offshore banking units for relending to third countries' borrowers amounted to 482.6 billion baht at the end of December, down from 487.6 billion baht at the end of previous month, the bank said.
